exposure: Women without substantial weight gain after GDM diagnosis
total gestational weight gain during pregnancy (0-36 weeks)
late gestational weight gain (28-36 weeks, after diagnosis)
early gestational weight gain (0-28 weeks, before GDM diagnosis)
Women with substantial weight gain after GDM diagnosis
outcome: Postpartum 2-h oral glucose tolerance test concentrations
cohort: 546 women with GDM who delivered viable singleton infants
finding: Higher total gestational weight gain was associated with Caesarean section and large for gestational age, while higher late gestational weight gain was associated with large for gestational age, instrumental deliveries, higher insulin doses, and higher postpartum glucose levels.
mod_finding: Higher total gestational weight gain was associated with Caesarean section.
